question: Which 5 states had the most storm events from 1980 to 1995, considering only the top 1000 states with the highest event counts each year? Please use state abbreviations.
sql:
WITH all_storms AS (
  SELECT '1980' as year, state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1980`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1981', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1981`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1982', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1982`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1983', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1983`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1984', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1984`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1985', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1985`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1986', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1986`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1987', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1987`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1988', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1988`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1989', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1989`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1990', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1990`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1991', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1991`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1992', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1992`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1993', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1993`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1994', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1994`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1995', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1995`
),
per_year_counts AS (
  SELECT year, state, state_fips_code, COUNT(*) as event_count
  FROM all_storms
  GROUP BY year, state, state_fips_code
),
top_1000_per_year AS (
  SELECT year, state, state_fips_code, event_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY event_count DESC) as rn
  FROM per_year_counts
)
SELECT state, state_fips_code, SUM(event_count) as total_events
FROM top_1000_per_year
WHERE rn <= 1000
GROUP BY state, state_fips_code
ORDER BY total_events DESC
LIMIT 5
